Map Chlorophyll over the entire surface of the Earth on a ~100 km scale.
Description

Map Chlorophyll over the entire surface of the Earth on a ~100 km scale. Measurement the red edge, the region of rapid change in leaf reflectance from changes in vegetation chlorophyll absorption and mesophyll scattering due to seasons or stress.
